title: Kenyan Semolina Ugali
description: A traditional African dish made with semolina flour, perfect for a post-workout meal. This recipe serves as a great source of carbohydrates to replenish energy stores.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: adjust to achieve the right consistency

instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the semolina flour and salt.
Gradually add in the water, stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
The ugali should be smooth and free of lumps. If it's too thick, add a little more water. If it's too thin, add a little more semolina flour.
Turn off the heat and let the ugali rest for 2-3 minutes.
Serve the ugali hot, garnished with a sprinkle of salt if desired.
